response.sql:
WITH circuit_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    c.circuitId,
    c.country,
    AVG(r.round) as circuit_avg_round
  FROM circuits c
  INNER JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.country
),
country_baselines AS (
  SELECT 
    country,
    AVG(circuit_avg_round) as country_baseline
  FROM circuit_avgs
  GROUP BY country
)
SELECT 
  ca.circuitId,
  ca.country,
  ca.circuit_avg_round,
  ca.circuit_avg_round - cb.country_baseline as difference
FROM circuit_avgs ca
LEFT JOIN country_baselines cb ON ca.country = cb.country
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: "Races whose circuit is in the circuits table" is satisfied by an INNER JOIN between circuits and races; circuits without races are excluded from all calculations.
